title: MiniMax H3 Turbo Video
description: Low-cold-start RunPod Serverless worker for MiniMax H3 FL2VA image-to-video. INT8 model and 4-step Turbo LoRA live on a Network Volume; optimized for RTX 4090 24 GB and RTX 5090 32 GB.

input.name: ComfyUI startup flags
input.description: Defaults to automatic offload with 1 GiB reserved for 24 GB GPUs.

input.name: Default Turbo LoRA
input.description: Set empty to disable the default four-step Turbo LoRA.
